description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) performance of the MADLLM model and its ablated variants across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score percentage, ranging from 60% to 100%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. The horizontal axis lists the datasets in the specified order. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, representing: MADLLM (green), MADLLM without feature embedding (purple), MADLLM without prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM without skip embedding (brown). On the SMD dataset, all four variants perform similarly, with scores around 90–93%. On PSM, MADLLM achieves the highest score (~97%), followed closely by the variant without feature embedding (~96%), while the variants without prompt pool and skip embedding score ~77% and ~95%, respectively. For SWaT, MADLLM scores ~91%, the variant without feature embedding ~90%, without prompt pool ~83%, and without skip embedding ~85%. On SMAP, MADLLM scores ~93%, while the ablated versions score ~70%, ~69%, and ~67%, respectively. For MSL, MADLLM scores ~87%, without feature embedding ~85%, without prompt pool ~69%, and without skip embedding ~86%. On WADI, MADLLM scores ~74%, without feature embedding ~62%, without prompt pool ~64%, and without skip embedding ~68%. The chart visually emphasizes that removing feature embedding or prompt pool generally degrades performance significantly, especially on SMAP and WADI, while the skip embedding ablation has a more variable impact. The bars are not sorted by height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
